clips.hook: This bridge has crashed over 200 trucks, and the fix was only 8 inches.
clips.caption:
This one bridge has wrecked over 200 trucks 🚛💥

The 11'8" bridge in North Carolina was so low that trucks kept getting stuck under it. In 2019 it was raised to 12'4", and the crashes dropped off.
